# For Mother Russia digital-book design adaptation

The author's unchanged `references/design/data_collection - for mother russia.png` is the visual source. `scripts/cut_mother_russia_board.py` derives the transparent photo-and-winter ring, its aligned river/cabin centre, a tighter homepage centre, a complete rectangular cabin vignette and a circular composition proof. The child remains entirely on the rotating ring, so his head and body turn together. The 394-pixel source circle supports the digital edition; it does not supply independently editable print layers or a printer-resolution master.

The board's **Chapter 03** is a concept-layout label. The v2 book retains **Chapter 08**, and the original edition's **05** remains preserved in the chapter metadata and legacy immersive copy. The homepage keeps the common book-cover ring and changes only its centre at this stop. The chapter map and reading leaf use the new For Mother Russia ring and scene. The reading leaf and desktop book preview show the rectangular cabin illustration. The separate immersive page uses the same circular portal and cabin while preserving its original essay, Memory Graph, gallery and film proof.

The selected `source/approved.md` manuscript and inherited A5/A4, film and social proofs remain unchanged. Those products retain their historical labels and separate release status.
